pwa.installSub: Get offline access and quick launch from your home screen

help.ios: Tap the Share button in Safari, then select "Add to Home Screen" to install CivicConnect like a native app.
help.android: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮), then tap "Install app" to add CivicConnect to your home screen.
help.desktop: Click the install icon (monitor with a download arrow) in your browser's address bar, or choose "Install CivicConnect" from the browser menu.
help.inapp: Open CivicConnect in your device's browser, then follow the install steps.

pwa.iosHelpBody: Tap the Share button in Safari, then choose "Add to Home Screen" to install CivicConnect like a native app. You'll get offline access and a home screen icon.

landing.heroSubtitle: Connect with local authorities, track issue resolution in real-time, and build a better city together. Your voice matters.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to report and track civic issues
landing.feature1Desc: Capture precise location and photo evidence for accurate reporting
landing.feature2Desc: Smart categorization and automatic routing to the right department
landing.feature3Desc: Monitor issue resolution status from submission to closure
landing.feature4Desc: English, Hindi, Marathi, and more languages supported
landing.feature5Desc: Save drafts offline and sync automatically when connected
landing.feature6Desc: Instant updates and alerts on complaint status changes
landing.howSubtitle: Simple steps to make a difference in your community
landing.step1Desc: Take a photo, add a description, and mark the location on the map. Our AI will automatically categorize and route your issue to the right department.
landing.step2Desc: Local authorities verify your complaint and assign it to the appropriate team. You'll receive instant notifications of each status update.
landing.step3Desc: Monitor real-time updates as workers address the issue. Get notifications when work starts and when the issue is resolved.
landing.step4Desc: Confirm that the issue has been resolved and share your feedback. Help us improve civic services for everyone.
landing.benefit1Desc: Issues are resolved 3x faster with our streamlined process
landing.benefit2Desc: Your data is encrypted and protected with industry standards
landing.benefit3Desc: Join thousands of citizens making positive change
landing.benefit4Desc: See the real impact of your reports with detailed metrics
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of citizens building better communities. Start reporting civic issues today.
